item.title: [AINews] November 24, 2026: Qwen4-Max MoE, OpenRLHF Async Rollouts, and TRL Updates
item.content:encoded:
• Qwen4-Max Official Launch (2.4T Sparse MoE, 71B Active, 1M Context): Alibaba Tongyi debuted Qwen4-Max featuring a 2.4T total parameter sparse MoE architecture with 71B active parameters, native image/video multimodal perception, and a 1M-token context window while developer tracking focuses on upcoming dense open-weight Qwen4 variants.
  • OpenRLHF Async Multi-Turn Agent Buffer Patch: Community update in OpenRLHF v0.6.4 adds asynchronous multi-turn trajectory replay buffers for VLM PPO rollouts.
  • TRL v0.16 Minor Docs Update: Routine documentation cleanup in huggingface/trl for GRPO trainer logging flags.
  • vLLM CUDA 13.0 Nightly Wheel: Experimental nightly wheels in vLLM CUDA 13 with LibTorch Stable ABI migration.
  • MolmoWeb Trajectory Viewer: AllenAI pushed a lightweight trajectory replay inspector in MolmoWeb Viewer for debugging browser click failures.
  • SGLang TorchTPU Backend: PyTorch-native plugin update in SGLang-TorchTPU for low-latency MoE serving.
